Title: Nitin and the Family

Cast

1. Nitin - 28 years, son
Look: white kurta-pyjama
2. Vinod - 66 years, father
Look: moustache, checked shirt
3. Shalini - 27 years, daughter
Look: green saree
4. Sanjay - 38 years, friend
Look: glasses, brown sweater

Places

1. The mall - a row of shops, an escalator

Scene 1: The mall - Day

[Nitin stands in the mall. Vinod and Shalini stand near him.]

Vinod: "Today feels like a good day."

[Nitin tries on a new jacket.]

Vinod: "Careful!"

[Nitin carries the shopping bags out.]

Vinod: "I really enjoyed today."
